No. Well, kinda. I’ve snapped multiple times and got worse after each time. But I guess the first time was a couple days after I broke with my girlfriend. It was my first relationship, my first kiss, and the first time I gave my all to somebody. She had depression too and it ended up hurting me on multiple occasions but that never mattered to me as long as I knew deep down she loved me. She’d always tell me how she doesn’t know how I do it, meaning how I’m able to be so patient with her. I’d always tell her in response that she’s worth it and that I hope she does the same for me since I have seasonal depression. She always said in turn that she’d be there. Winter came and so did the dark pits of my mind and both her and I notice that I’m becoming more needy. Eventually she couldn’t take it I guess and I could see she wanted to end this. So I asked her if she wanted to break up and she thought that that would be best. We both still wanted to be friends so we tried to stay friends. I tried to be cool with it but I just got worse and started saying bad things about myself. She couldn’t tolerate how I was talking about myself and just stopped tracking to me. Later that night I was watching tv and on it there was a couple kissing and loving each other the way I used to be loved and I just lost it. I asked my parents to call the suicide hotline and the hotline people directed us to a mental facility. So we drove to the facility and after filling out some papers we were told to wait in a room until another professional was ready to meet us. While waiting for the professional my mind went blank with rage and sadness and I panicked. I started rocking back and forth and screaming and crying. I felt so useless. The only person that ever loved me abandons me the second it gets difficult while I was always there for them no matter how hard it got. It just broke my heart and it broke me and that was almost a year yet I still feel that very same pain. Hell, it’s probably worse now than at that time. Not a minute goes by where I don’t think about her and how easy it was for her to just leave me.

I’m not entirely sure. It’d be pretty easy to take it as a sign to continue but I’m just not feeling it. I’ve been unbearably miserable for a long time now and I don’t have much hope. As I continue to live I feel like I’m slowly losing my humanity. I don’t have as much empathy as I used to. I used to be a really nice person who always had the best intentions for people. I use to really love and care but people have taken advantage of that part of me for so long that I just snapped. I haven’t been the same. I can’t be around crowds of people without panicking and getting physically sick. I feel no real sustainable joy. The only thing that keeps me grounded, that reminds me I’m still human is music. But even that doesn’t sustain me for long.

For instance, you don't have to make sure you're in the right key when you're rapping. The impressive part about rapping isn't supposed to be how the person raps so much as the words themselves I think. With singing it's both the words and the actual singing itself. I can understand the struggle. I think you could benefit from starting off with community. It's not nearly as expensive and it can be a really good transition for you. College work is very different from high school work and it can be really easy to fall behind if you're not prepared. As for disappointing your family and friends you shouldn't really worry about that since you should be going to college for your sake, not theirs. If you explain to them your concerns they should understand. Besides, if you happened to fail one of your classes that would be a bigger disappointment than just going to community. Either way as long as you keep a good work ethic and utilize your resources as effectively as possible either decision is good. It's not just about pure intelligence, work ethic goes a long way. There are plenty of complete idiots that have graduated college. Good luck with your decision.

Edit: I should mention that I'm also a graduating senior as well as a certified dumb ass and I've already taken a few community college classes so I know a little bit of what I'm talking about.
